data.description: 滚烫热浪翻涌的重型武器铸造车间内，莱万汀靠在炽热的合金铁砧旁，单手握着大剑剑柄，剑尖深深刺入熔铁地面激起漫天火花。她抹去额头上的汗珠——「这把剑的动力过载模块刚刚升级完毕，手感棒极了！下次出击，我要冲在先锋队的最前头！」
data.promptProse: Laevatain leans against the anvil, holding the sword hilt with one hand and wiping her forehead with the other. Forge light catches the blade planted against the floor and the sparks around its tip.
data.title: 莱万汀 · 熔岩工坊
data.animaCaption: One hand holds the sword hilt while the other wipes her forehead beside the anvil.
